definitions.explanation: A single powerful hit or attack, whether physical or metaphorical.

examples.japanese: {一撃|いちげき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{倒|たお}す→倒す：01954_taosu⟧。
examples.english: I knock them down with one blow.

examples.japanese: {一撃|いちげき}{必殺|ひっさつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{技|わざ}→技：02172_waza⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{放|はな}つ→放つ：10062_hanatsu⟧。
examples.english: I unleash a one-hit kill technique.

examples.japanese: ⟦{強烈|きょうれつ}→強烈：15109_kyouretsu⟧な{一撃|いちげき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けて→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧⟦{倒|たお}れた→倒れる：01160_taoreru⟧。
examples.english: He fell after receiving a powerful blow.

notes:
{一撃|いちげき} emphasizes the power and decisiveness of a single strike.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {一撃|いちげき}{必殺|ひっさつ}: one-hit kill, instant death attack
- {一撃|いちげき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{仕留|しと}める→仕留める：30023_shitomeru⟧: to finish with a single blow
- {一撃|いちげき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{加|くわ}える→加える：01941_kuwaeru⟧: to deliver a blow
- {痛恨|つうこん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{一撃|いちげき}: a devastating blow

USAGE:
Often used in martial arts, gaming, and dramatic contexts. Can also be used figuratively for decisive actions or criticisms.
